senses.gloss: f. (b. h.) purple-shell, a bluish or cerulean dye, purple-blue wool, esp. the purple-blue thread used for the show-fringes.
units: Sot. 46ᵇ היא לוז שצובעין בה ת׳ that is the city of Luz where they dye the t’kheleth (v. לוּז I).
<cite ref="Menachot 38a:9">Ib. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>מצוה … לבן לת׳</he> it is proper to take the white thread first and then the blue.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:3">Num. R. s. 18<sup>3</sup></cite> <he>טלית שכולה ת׳ מהו וכ׳</he> if a cloak is made entirely of blue wool, is it exempt from show-fringes? <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:3">Ib.</cite> <he>טלית שכולה ת׳ אינה וכ׳</he> a cloak entirely of blue wool does not release (is insufficient for compliance with the law), and four threads are sufficient?; a. v. fr.
